posts.description: AI writing and validating ALL the code. Not some. All.

posts.title: AI assisted executive presence
posts.description: The author developed a daily task that reviews their communication, offering feedback on how effectively they convey messages. Each morning, it analyzes yesterday's emails, chats, and meeting transcripts to identify weaknesses in clarity, conviction, and ownership. The output targets three significant moments, fostering improved executive presence and self-awareness.

posts.title: Review by asking, not asserting
posts.description: This week, I reviewed a design proposal, focusing on boundaries and responsibilities, often asking questions rather than giving opinions. These inquiries reveal untested assumptions and clarify design intent. This approach proved effective when a reported integration issue was resolved by simply verifying the last test run, demonstrating the value of clear communication.
